sources.title: IXI normal healthy-subject MR dataset · selected native MRA
sources.citation: IXI – Information eXtraction from Images, EPSRC GR/S21533/02. Brain Development: IXI Dataset. https://brain-development.org/ixi-dataset/. Selected source: IXI002-Guys-0828-MRA.nii.gz.

scope_notes: The publisher describes IXI as a normal healthy-subject cohort. This selected image has not received independent case-specific anatomical or teaching review.
One original MRA image is provided with no artery segmentation, branch names, tissue surfaces or computed vessel-radius estimates. Bright image signal alone does not identify a vessel.
The acquired slab is approximately 240 by 240 by 80 mm. Full sections mean the complete acquired field of view, not complete coverage of the brain or all cranial vessels.

The original oblique affine, left-handed voxel axes, coded forms, millimeter units and source intensity samples are retained byte for byte. Native RAS coordinates are not an AC-PC or template registration.
Three-dimensional intensity rendering and contrast changes are display settings. They do not create a validated vascular surface or establish vessel continuity.
Other IXI participants and contrasts remain in their own spaces. Matching participant identifiers or equal header dimensions alone do not validate multimodal correspondence.
No population variation prevalence, pathological interpretation or clinical use is provided.
acquisition: Run neuroimage acquire ixi_mra --data-root <existing-data-root>. Verified extracted inputs are reused directly. Otherwise retain the official IXI-MRA.tar and selectively extract the pinned selected image; do not expand the whole cohort.
